nodes.label: Android Adaptive Icon
nodes.rationale: Android launcher icon format that composes separate background and foreground layers (plus an optional monochrome layer) so the system can apply masks, parallax, and themed tinting. Punto realizes it as three files referenced from app.json under android.adaptiveIcon: foregroundImage, backgroundImage and monochromeImage.

nodes.label: Android Adaptive Icon Background Layer
nodes.rationale: 512x512 full-bleed square, solid soft light-blue (#E6F4FE, RGB 230,244,254) with no transparency. Serves as the base color plate of the Android adaptive icon; the foreground mark is composited on top. The light tint is chosen so the darker blue foreground mark keeps high contrast in both light and dark launchers.

nodes.label: Android Adaptive Icon Foreground Mark
nodes.rationale: 512x512 RGBA with a transparent field and a centered blue (#0274E0, RGB 2,116,224) mark whose alpha bounding box is roughly (127,131)-(387,371). The shape reads as a stylized upward chevron / inverted-V (peak or '∧' with a notched base), matching the Punto 'punto'/'point' identity. It is inset within the adaptive-icon safe zone so launcher masks (circle, squircle, rounded square) never crop it.

nodes.label: Android Adaptive Icon Monochrome Layer
nodes.rationale: 432x432 RGBA silhouette filled uniformly in gray (#7D7D7D, RGB 125,125,125) with a transparent field, alpha bounding box roughly (117,123)-(313,299). It carries the same inverted-V mark as the foreground so Android themed icons can recolor it with the system accent.

nodes.label: Adaptive Icon Layer Separation Design
nodes.rationale: Separating the icon into a full-bleed background color plate, an inset foreground mark, and a monochrome silhouette lets one brand mark adapt to arbitrary launcher masks and to Android 13+ themed icons without shipping per-shape assets. The foreground is deliberately inset to survive aggressive mask cropping.

nodes.label: Punto Brand Mark (Upward Chevron)
nodes.rationale: The favicon is a rounded-square squircle on a pale blue field containing a bold blue upward chevron. It functions as the minimal, flat, border-based Punto brand mark: a simple upward angle suggesting growth, order, and a clear next action, rendered in the same royal blue family as the design system color-primary-500 (#2563EB). No text, no shadows, no gradients, matching the AGENTS.md brand personality of clarity, simplicity, and practical confidence rather than corporate or playful.

nodes.label: Brand Glow Backdrop Asset
nodes.rationale: A soft, heavily-blurred radial gradient blob in a light royal blue (#2563EB-family) on a white background. It functions as a decorative brand halo/backdrop behind the Punto logo, reinforcing the primary accent color while keeping the flat, minimal, low-shadow visual language (AGENTS.md 7.1, 7.4). The diffuse edges and low opacity avoid a hard shadow, matching the product's 'borders over shadows' aesthetic and preserving WCAG-friendly text contrast over the light neutral background.
